prompt_md: How many whole numbers from 1 to 1,000 are divisible by 3, by 5 or by 7 (by at least one of them)?
hint_md: Numbers divisible by two of them got counted twice.
explain_intuition_md: Adding 333 + 200 + 142 = 675 counts every multiple of 15, 21 or 35 twice. Subtracting those takes away too much from the multiples of 105, which have to be added back.
